correctness.rationale: The exact orthogonal sum/difference decomposition gives t^+=t[(1-eta*tanh(kappa*t/(1+t)))/abs(1-eta)]^2, with sign change of U only for eta>1. For eta in (1,2], G is strictly increasing since 2eta*t*tau′<=kappa<1-eta*tau when kappa<=1/3. Its unique interior fixed ratio exists exactly for 2/(1+tanh(kappa))<eta<2; monotonic iteration establishes global attraction without overshoot. The x-configuration at this fixed ratio is exchanged with signs every step. Endpoint consensus and antipodal pairs are treated separately. Expanding G at infinity and zero proves the two universal n*(1+c) and n*(1-c) limits. Standard-library verify.py tests 1890 conjugacy/orientation identities, 45 sample phase trajectories and two rates; tests are not a substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: A complete globally valid bifurcation/attractor classification for a natural minimal nontrivial negative-value attention dynamical system, with an interior family of prime-two exchange attractors absent from two-token diagonally masked models, explicitly sharp parameter transitions and two nontrivial universal critical rates.
